name: Stream-RAG synthetic workshop and travel corpus

documents.title: Pune workshop capacity
documents.text: Cedar Hall in Pune has a workshop capacity of 40 people seated at tables. The room includes a projector and a whiteboard.

documents.title: Pune workshop cancellation
documents.text: Workshop cancellation in Pune is free at least 7 days before the booking. Later cancellation retains 25 percent of the venue fee.

documents.title: Pune workshop catering
documents.text: Cedar Hall in Pune offers vegetarian workshop catering for INR 450 per person. Meal counts must be confirmed two days before the workshop.

documents.title: Pune workshop parking
documents.text: Cedar Hall in Pune provides 12 visitor parking spaces. Parking reservations must be included with the workshop booking.

documents.title: Workshop accessibility policy
documents.text: All demo workshop venues provide step-free entry and an accessible restroom. Accessibility requests can be included with the booking.

documents.title: Domestic travel reimbursement
documents.text: Domestic travel reimbursement requires an itemized receipt and manager approval. Submit the claim within 30 days after travel.

documents.title: International travel reimbursement
documents.text: International travel reimbursement requires an itemized receipt, manager approval, and foreign currency conversion evidence. Submit the claim within 30 days after travel.

documents.title: Booking approval before travel
documents.text: Booking before travel requires manager approval before the reservation is confirmed.

documents.title: Booking approval after travel
documents.text: Booking after travel requires senior director approval and a written exception explaining the late booking.
